text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: performance cycle reminder next month. We're planning a drop-in Q&A + spot-award pop-up during the week of reviews to keep morale high.
Tom Becker: Good timing. Any guidance on issuing spot awards during review week? want to avoid confusion with formal calibration.
Olivia Reed: HR note: spot awards for recognition are independent of calibration. Communicate that clearly to managers. We can allow spot awards but they should not be referenced in calibration packets.
Marcus Liu: will facilities help with a small table outside review rooms?
Aisha Khan: yes, booked lobby table Wed 12-2 for drop-ins. Tom can you handle volunteer schedule?
Tom Becker: yep 2 volunteers per slot. I'll post sign-up in the sheet.
people-bot: FYI: `/issue-spot-award` logs awards in HR ledger. Please tag with `review-week` label for tracking.
Olivia Reed: also prepping a 1-pager for managers to clarify: spot awards vs formal reward. I'll share link when ready.
Aisha Khan: action items: Olivia finalizes manager note by Fri; Tom posts volunteer sign-up; people-bot will tag awards.
Tom Becker: on it. thanks!
